atoms.title: Passwords and password policies
atoms.objective: Evaluate a password against a formal policy (length, complexity, history, lockout) and explain why each rule reduces the risk of unauthorized access.

atoms.title: Multi-factor authentication

atoms.title: Session security

atoms.title: Least privilege and access control models
atoms.objective: Explain the principle of least privilege, describe why over-privileged accounts increase risk, distinguish DAC, MAC, RBAC, and ABAC access control models, and recognize privilege creep and the controls that mitigate it.
